authority_topology.application_data_plane: one ApplicationCell per application; application-facing sessions hold only their bound cell
authority_topology.control_plane: ControlPlane owns lifecycle, credential registry, and cell provisioning
authority_topology.provisioning_plane: ControlPlane.provision_application; not reachable from ApplicationRuntime or ApplicationDeveloper
authority_topology.audit_plane: immutable-snapshot AuditSink on the local API path; application sessions have no mutation API

credential_semantics.secret_storage: pepper-backed digest only; secret returned once at issuance
credential_semantics.revocation: checked on every session opening and operation; unavailable authorization state fails closed

structured_operations.transaction: all operations commit or rollback as one local transaction
structured_operations.destructive_data_operation: declare-and-echo confirmation required (contract 1.2.0 destructive_confirmation): destructive=true and confirm must exactly equal the server's own currently-recomputed required_confirmation phrase for this exact request; a truthy-but-non-matching confirm is refused, never accepted

resource_bounds.note: matches spec/data-service-api.v1.json limits.classes membership exactly (Q1-D7(B)/Q1-D11, design docs/design/DESTRUCTIVE_CONFIRMATION_V1.md v1.5 §7) -- max_fields-gated shape checks (schema-field count, read-projection width, write-payload width) are VALIDATION_FAILED, not a resource_bounds class, per Q1-D11

platform_evidence_required_before_produc: Cloud Run identity has no Control Plane or provisioning credentials
Cloud SQL access is restricted to the application data authority
audit sink is append-only and separately governed
